and mercifully enshrines the Name in your mind?

445V: All beings and creatures are His; He belongs to all.
The mortals and creatures are all His and He belongs to all.
7W5T: So who can we call bad, since there is no other? ||4||
Whom should we call bad? If there be any other, then we may.
X16B: The Command of the One Lord is pervading throughout; duty to the One Lord is upon the heads of all.
The order of the Lord alone holds away over all and no their head is the duty enjoined by the One Lord.
CDDQ: He Himself has led them astray, and placed greed and corruption within their hearts. ||5||
He Himself has led astray the beings, so within their heart abide avarice and vice.
JEF6: He has sanctified those few Gurmukhs who understand Him, and reflect upon Him.
Some He Himself has consecrated and they understand and remember Him.
QQTP: He grants devotional worship to them, and within them is the treasure. ||6||
His devotional service too, He donates to them, and within them is the treasure of devotion.
5W3Y: The spiritual teachers know nothing but the Truth; they obtain true understanding.
The divine scholars know nothing but truth as they obtain true understanding.
PHW9: They are led astray by Him, but they do not go astray, because they know the True Lord. ||7||
Led astray by another, they go not astray. They know the True Lord.
6NQ8: Within the homes of their bodies, the five passions are pervading, but here, the five are well-behaved.
Within their body are the five evil passions, but here the five act wisely.
4XK7: O Nanak, without the True Guru, they are not overcome; through the Naam, the ego is conquered. ||8||5||27||
Nanak, without the True Guru, they are not subdued. Through the Name, self-conceit is stilled.
B61K: Everything is within the home of your own self; there is nothing beyond it.
In your own home is everything, O man, and there is nothing without.
AD08: By Guru's Grace, it is obtained, and the doors of the inner heart are opened wide. ||1||
By Guru's grace everything is obtained and the doors of the mind are opened.
3BZL: From the True Guru, the Lord's Name is obtained, O Siblings of Destiny.
From the True Guru, God is attained, O brother.
D7E8: The treasure of the Naam is within; the Perfect True Guru has shown this to me. ||1||Pause||
The Name Treasure is within the man, which the perfect Sat Guru has shown it to me. Pause.
1NLN: One who is a buyer of the Lord's Name, finds it, and obtains the jewel of contemplation.
He, who is the purchaser of God's Name, finds it and obtains the gem of meditation.
2TC3: He opens the doors deep within, and through the Eyes of Divine Vision, beholds the treasure of liberation. ||2||
He opens his mind, and through the Divine glance beholds the treasure of salvation.
W2P3: There are so many mansions within the body; the soul dwells within them.
Within the body are many mansions, and the soul dwells therein.
UKZY: He obtains the fruits of his mind's desires, and he shall not have to go through reincarnation again. ||3||
He obtains the fruit his heart desires and transmigrates not, again.
BCJY: The appraisers cherish the commodity of the Name; they obtain understanding from the Guru.
The assayers obtain understanding from the Guru and take care of the Name commodity.
M302: The wealth of the Naam is priceless; how few are the Gurmukhs who obtain it. ||4||
The wealth of Lord's Name is priceless and through the Guru, a few obtain it.
CWE8: Searching outwardly, what can anyone find? The commodity is deep within the home of the self, O Siblings of Destiny.
By searching without, what can he find? The real Thing is within the home (heart), O brother.
03D7: The entire world is wandering around, deluded by doubt; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||5||
The whole world wanders astray in doubt. The perverse persons lose his honour.
E1RT: The false one leaves his own hearth and home, and goes out to another's home.
The false man leaves his own home and door and goes to another's home.
MYU2: Like a thief, he is caught, and without the Naam, he is beaten and struck down. ||6||
He is caught like a thief and without the Name, he suffers strokes.
XLDY: Those who know their own home, are happy, O Siblings of Destiny.
They, who know their Home, are happy, my brother.
0TS7: They realize God within their own hearts, through the glorious greatness of the Guru. ||7||
Through the Guru's glory, they recognise the Omnipresent Lord in their heart.
T15G: He Himself gives gifts, and He Himself bestows understanding; to whom can we complain?
The Lord Himself gives gifts and Himself bestows understanding, and there is none to complain to.
G78R: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and you shall obtain glory in the True Court. ||8||6||28||
Nanak, meditate you on the Name, so shall you obtain glory in the True court.

HXPJ: Those who recognize their own selves, enjoy the sweet flavor, O Siblings of Destiny.
They, who recognise their ownself, enjoy the sweet savour, O brother.
N90S: Those who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord are emancipated; they love the Truth. ||1||
They who love the truth, get emancipated by quaffing God's elixir.
SRLZ: The Beloved Lord is the purest of the pure; He comes to dwell in the pure mind.
The reverend Lord is the purest of the pure, and abides in the pure mind.
DVQE: Praising the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, one remains unaffected by corruption. ||1||Pause||
Praising God under Guru's instruction, one remains unaffected by deadly passions. Pause.
UNYR: Without the Word of the Shabad, they do not understand themselves -they are totally blind, O Siblings of Destiny.
Without the Name, man understands not his own self and sans it all are blind, O Brother.
SBKB: Through the Guru's Teachings, the heart is illuminated, and in the end, only the Naam shall be your companion. ||2||
By Guru, instruction there is mind's illumination and in the end God's Name is the man's succourer.
1QEJ: They are occupied with the Naam, and only the Naam; they deal only in the Naam.
They abide in nothing but the Name and deal only in the Name.
32PX: Deep within their hearts is the Naam; upon their lips is the Naam; they contemplate the Word of God, and the Naam. ||3||
In their heart is the Name, in their mouth is the Name, in their mouth is the Name, and God's Name they contemplate.
LLWB: They listen to the Naam, believe in the Naam, and through the Naam, they obtain glory.
They hear the Name, believe in the Name and through the Name obtain glory.
QME2: They praise the Naam, forever and ever, and through the Naam, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||
Ever, ever they praise the Name and through the Name attain to Lord's mansion.
PGJ1: Through the Naam, their hearts are illumined, and through the Naam, they obtain honor.
Through the Name is their mind illumined and through the Name they obtain honour.
LSV9: Through the Naam, peace wells up; I seek the Sanctuary of the Naam. ||5||
By God's Name peace is procured, so I seek the Name's protection.
W2BX: Without the Naam, no one is accepted; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor.
Without the Name no one is accepted and the apostate lose their honour.
DUD7: In the City of Death, they are tied down and beaten, and they lose their lives in vain. ||6||
They are tied and thrashed in the City of death and lose their life in vain.
F6XE: Those Gurmukhs who realize the Naam, all serve the Naam.
All the men, to whom the Name is revealed through the Guru, serve the Guru, serve the Lord's Name.
M7P0: So believe in the Naam, and only the Naam; through the Naam, glorious greatness is obtained. ||7||
The Name alone worship you, O man, and through the Name honour is attained.
D8MT: He alone receives it, to whom it is given. Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is realized.
He alone receives the Name, to whom the Guru gives. By Guru's instruction the Name is realised.
7QU7: O Nanak, everything is under the influence of the Naam; by perfect good destiny, a few obtain it. ||8||7||29||
Nanak, everything is under the sway of the Name. Through perfect good fortune, a few obtain the Name.
Q42C: The deserted brides do not obtain the Mansion of their Husband's Presence, nor do they know His taste.
The deserted wives attain not their Husband's palace, nor know His relish.
27L5: They speak harsh words, and do not bow to Him; they are in love with another. ||1||
They speak harshly, bow not to the Lord and relish another's love.
GHRU: How can this mind come under control?
How can this mind come under control.
3YPR: By Guru's Grace, it is held in check; instructed in spiritual wisdom, it returns to its home. ||1||Pause||
By Guru, grace it is restrained, and instructed in Divine Knowledge it returns home. Pause.
75BZ: He Himself adorns the happy soul-brides; they bear Him love and affection.
The true (faithful) wives, the Spouse Himself has adorned. They bear Him and affection.
SLPA: They live in harmony with the Sweet Will of the True Guru, naturally adorned with the Naam. ||2||
They live according to True Guru's will and are, easily, decorated with the Lord's Name.
M2FN: They enjoy their Beloved forever, and their bed is decorated with Truth.
They ever enjoy their Beloved and their couch is truly embellished.
2E8M: They are fascinated with the Love of their Husband Lord; meeting their Beloved, they obtain peace. ||3||
They are fascinated with the love of their Spouse and obtain peace on meeting their Darling.
WXF1: Spiritual wisdom is the incomparable decoration of the happy soul-bride.
Divine Knowledge is the incomparable decoration of the illustrious woman.
3EEZ: She is so beautiful - she is the queen of all; she enjoys the love and affection of her Husband Lord. ||4||
Through the love and affection of her Spouse, she is beautiful and the queen of all.
P8AT: The True Lord, the Unseen, the Infinite, has infused His Love among the happy soul-brides.
Among the happy wives the True, Unseen and Endless Lord has infused His love.
QUYY: They serve their True Guru, with true love and affection. ||5||
They serve their True Guru, with the genuine love and affection.
TTQW: The happy soul-bride has adorned herself with the necklace of virtue.
The chaste wife has decorated herself by wearing necklace of virtues, around her neck.
UC7W: She applies the perfume of love to her body, and within her mind is the jewel of reflective meditation. ||6||
She applies the perfume of love to her body and within her mind is the jewel of meditation.
6TX2: Those who are imbued with devotional worship are the most exalted. Their social standing and honor come from the Word of the Shabad.
They, who are imbued with devotion are the exalted. The caste and honour result from the Name.
GV91: Without the Naam, all are low class, like maggots in manure. ||7||
Without the Name, every one is of low caste and becomes the worm of ordure.
FTLK: Everyone proclaims, "Me, me!"; but without the Shabad, the ego does not depart.
Every one goes about saying, I, I without God's Name egotism departs not.
WGZG: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam lose their ego; they remain absorbed in the True Lord. ||8||8||30||
Nanak, they who are dyed with the Name, lose pride and remain absorbed in the True Lord.
9FJD: Those who are imbued with the True Lord are spotless and pure; their reputation is forever true.
They who are imbued with the True One, are pure and ever true is their reputation.
DA4L: Here, they are known in each and every home, and hereafter, they are famous throughout the ages. ||1||
Here they are renowned in every house, and hereafter, they are distinguished all the ages through.

M253: O beauteous and joyful mind, imbue yourself with your true color.
O my beauteous joyful soul, adopt you the true colour.
V3SP: If you imbue yourself with the Beauteous Word of the Guru's Bani, then this color shall never fade away. ||1||Pause||
If you are imbued with the beautiful hymn of the Guru, then this colour shall neither fade nor depart. Pause.
BCQ0: I am lowly, filthy, and totally egotistical; I am attached to the corruption of duality.
I am vile, filthy, exceedingly proud, sinful and attached to another's love.
D9UQ: But meeting with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone, I am transformed into gold; I am blended with the Pure Light of the Infinite Lord. ||2||
Coming into contact with Guru, the Philosopher's stone, I am transformed into gold and am blended with the pure Light of the Infinite Lord.
13TD: Without the Guru, no one is imbued with the color of the Lord's Love; meeting with the Guru, this color is applied.
Without the Guru, none is dyed with Lord's love. On meeting the Guru the dye is applied.
GH9X: Those who are imbued with the Fear, and the Love of the Guru, are absorbed in the Praise of the True Lord. ||3||
They, who are dyed with the fear and love of the Guru, merge into the praise of the True Lord.
UME7: Without fear, the cloth is not dyed, and the mind is not rendered pure.
Without fear, the love of God is not produced, not does the heart become pure.
XCM3: Without fear, the performance of rituals is false, and one finds no place of rest. ||4||
Without Lord's fear the performance of rituals is false and the mortal finds no place of rest.
PH01: Only those whom the Lord imbues, are so imbued; they join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
He, whom the Lord Himself imbues is so imbued and he meets the guild of saints.
XV88: From the Perfect Guru, the Sat Sangat emanates, and one easily merges into the Love of the True One. ||5||
From the Perfect Guru, the guild of saints is obtained and the man, easily embraces the glorious love of the True One.
0P85: Without the Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all remain like beasts and animals.
Without the society of the righteous, all the men remain like beasts and animals.
FCYW: They do not know the One who created them; without the Name, all are thieves. ||6||
They know not Him, who made them. Without the Name all are thieves.
9AKA: Some purchase merits and sell off their demerits; through the Guru, they obtain peace and poise.
Some purchase merits and sell off demerits through the Guru given equipoise and disposition.
48DJ: Serving the Guru, they obtain the Name, which comes to dwell deep within. ||7||
Through Guru's service, the Name is attained and the Lord comes to abide in the mind.
DQNH: The One Lord is the Giver of all; He assigns tasks to each and every person.
The One Lord is the Giver of all. He assigns every one his occupation.
ZA20: O Nanak, the Lord embellishes us with the Name; attached to the Word of the Shabad, we are merged into Him. ||8||9||31||
O Nanak, the Lord embellishes the man, by attaching him with His Name and by means of Gurbani blends him with Himself.
6YHF: Everyone longs for the Name, but he alone receives it, to whom the Lord shows His Mercy.
All people long for the Name, but he alone receives it to whom the Lord shows favour.
KAHA: Without the Name, there is only pain; he alone obtains peace, whose mind is filled with the Name. ||1||
Without the Name there is all distress. He alone attains peace, in whose mind, the Lord implants His Name.
MBYG: You are infinite and merciful; I seek Your Sanctuary.
You O Lord are Infinite and Merciful. I crave for Yours refuge,
3LBD: From the Perfect Guru, the glorious greatness of the Naam is obtained. ||1||Pause||
From the Perfect Guru, the greatness of the Name is obtained. Pause.
HMST: Inwardly and outwardly, there is only the One Lord. He has created the world, with its many varieties.
Within and without is the One Lord. He has created the world of various Kinds.
UPFS: According to the Order of His Will, He makes us act. What else can we talk about, O Siblings of Destiny? ||2||
He Makes man do the work, according to His will, who else is there to talk about, O brother?
76B3: Knowledge and ignorance are all your making; You have control over these.
Knowledge and ignorance art Yours creation. You have away over these.
Z447: Some, You forgive, and unite with Yourself; while others, the wicked, you strike down and drive out of Your Court. ||3||
Some You forgives and unitest with Yourself and some, the false ones, You smitest and drivest out of Your court.
N7J4: Some, from the very beginning, are pure and pious; You attach them to Your Name.
Some from the very beginning, are pure and pious, and them You have attached with Your Name.
4RAJ: Serving the Guru, peace wells up; through the True Word of the Shabad, one comes to understand. ||4||
By Guru's service, solace emanates and through the True Name man understands the Lord.
FTZQ: Some are crooked, filthy and vicious; the Lord Himself has led them astray from the Name.
Some are crooked, filthy and whore-hunters. The Lord Himself has led them astray from the Name.
JZXC: They have no intuition, no understanding and no self-discipline; they wander around delirious. ||5||
They have no comprehension, no wisdom, nor are they self-disciplined. They roam about wonder-struck.
8029: He grants faith to those whom He has blessed with His Glance of Grace.
He, on whom the Lord casts His merciful, glance, him He grants His faith.
PFYH: This mind finds truth, contentment and self-discipline, hearing the Immaculate Word of the Shabad. ||6||
Hearing the Immaculate Gurbani, this man attains truth, contentment and self-restraint.
UDR4: By reading books, one cannot reach Him; by speaking and talking, His limits cannot be found.
Reading Lord's account, one cannot reach Him, and by saying and uttering, His limit is not found.
T91X: Through the Guru, His value is found; through the True Word of the Shabad, understanding is obtained. ||7||
Through the Guru, Lord's worth is found and through the True Name His Knowledge is attained.
7W50: So reform this mind and body, by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Rectify you, this soul and body of yours by contemplating over Guru's hymns.
LQC9: O Nanak, within this body is the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; it is found through the Love of the Infinite Guru. ||8||10||32||
Nanak, within this body is the Name treasure, and through unbounded love for the Guru, this treasure is found.
XRLZ: The happy soul-brides are imbued with Truth; they are adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
The happy wives, who are adorned with Guru's word, are imbued in truth.

DDFJ: They find their Husband Lord within their own home, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||
Contemplating over the True Name, they obtained that Beloved in their own home.
Q0J4: Through merits, their demerits are forgiven, and they embrace love for the Lord.
Through merits are the demerits forgiven, and the mortal comes to embrace love for God.
K8AH: The soul-bride then obtains the Lord as her Husband; meeting the Guru, this union comes about. ||1||Pause||
The bride then attains God as her Groom and this union is brought about by the Guru. Pause.
THCA: Some do not know the Presence of their Husband Lord; they are deluded by duality and doubt.
Some know not the spouse's presence and are gone astray in duality and doubt.
6UMF: How can the forsaken brides meet Him? Their life night passes in pain. ||2||
How can the discarded wives meet their Lord? Their life night passes in distress.
3MRG: Those whose minds are filled with the True Lord, perform truthful actions.
They within whose mind the One abodes, do the righteous deeds.
DY0H: Night and day, they serve the Lord with poise, and are absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||
Night and day they serve God with equipoise and get absorbed in the True Lord.
AR61: The forsaken brides wander around, deluded by doubt; telling lies, they eat poison.
The forsaken women wander in doubt and eat poison by telling lies.
2M5S: They do not know their Husband Lord, and upon their deserted bed, they suffer in misery. ||4||
They know not their Spouse and suffer agony on the forlorn couch.
TN8A: The True Lord is the One and only; do not be deluded by doubt, O my mind.
The True Lord is but One, beware you be beguiled by doubt, O my soul.
HHYB: Consult with the Guru, serve the True Lord, and enshrine the Immaculate Truth within your mind. ||5||
Consult the Guru, serve your Lord and enshrine the pure True Name in your mind.
S5K4: The happy soul-bride always finds her Husband Lord; she banishes egotism and self-conceit.
The faithful bride ever obtains her Spouse and banishes her ego and self-conceit.
Z9HQ: She remains attached to her Husband Lord, night and day, and she finds peace upon His Bed of Truth. ||6||
With her Beloved, she night and day remains attached, and attains joy on the True couch.
SXPA: Those who shouted, "Mine, mine!" have departed, without obtaining anything.
They who said "it is mine, it is mine have departed without obtaining anything".
E6ZN: The separated one does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and departs, repenting in the end. ||7||
The separated one attains not to her Lord's mansion and depart repenting in the end.
VBMH: That Husband Lord of mine is the One and only; I am in love with the One alone.
That Beloved of mine is only one and I bear love with one alone.
L1GH: O Nanak, if the soul-bride longs for peace, she should enshrine the Lord's Name within her mind. ||8||11||33||
Nanak, if the damsel desires peace, the should then enshrine God's Name in her mind.
LEK0: Those whom the Lord has caused to drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, naturally, intuitively, enjoy the sublime essence.
They whom the Lord has caused to quaff the Name-Nectar, naturally enjoy the relish of it.
ZJDH: The True Lord is care-free; he does not have even an iota of greed. ||1||
The True Lord is care-free and He has not even an iota of avarice.
JQPG: The True Ambrosial Nectar rains down, and trickles into the mouths of the Gurmukhs.
The true Nectar rains and trickles down the mouth of the Guru-wards.
KDQZ: Their minds are forever rejuvenated, and they naturally, intuitively, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Even verdant is their soul and they automatically sing God's praise. Pause.
Q1PF: The self-willed manmukhs are forever forsaken brides; they cry out and bewail at the Lord's Gate.
The perverse ever behave like discarded women and your bewail standing at the door.
K3YY: Those who do not enjoy the sublime taste of their Husband Lord, act according to their pre-ordained destiny. ||2||
They who enjoy not the relish of their Dear Spouse, do that what is pre-ordained for them since the very beginning.
3MRR: The Gurmukh plants the seed of the True Name, and it sprouts. He deals in the True Name alone.
The Guru-ward sows the True Name and it sprouts. He deals in the True Name alone.
G97S: Those whom the Lord has attached to this profitable venture, are granted the treasure of devotional worship. ||3||
They, whom the Lord attaches to this profitable concern, them He grants the treasure of His devotional service.
J6VT: The Gurmukh is forever the true, happy soul-bride; she adorns herself with the fear of God and devotion to Him.
The Guru-ward is ever the true bride and she bedecks herself with her Lord's fear and meditation.
GXK7: Night and day, she enjoys her Husband Lord; she keeps Truth enshrined within her heart. ||4||
Night and day she enjoys her Groom and keeps truth clasped to her mind.
2J31: I am a sacrifice to those who have enjoyed their Husband Lord.
I am a sacrifice to those, who have enjoyed their beloved groom.
CM46: They dwell forever with their Husband Lord; they eradicate self-conceit from within. ||5||
Eradicating self-conceit from within, they ever abide with their Spouse.
J7AM: Their bodies and minds are cooled and soothed, and their faces are radiant, from the love and affection of their Husband Lord.
Through the love and affection of their spouse, their body and mind are cooled and their face becomes bright.
SHZP: They enjoy their Husband Lord upon His cozy bed, having conquered their ego and desire. ||6||
Having stilled her ego and avarice, the bride enjoys her Groom on the comfortable couch.
1PYN: Granting His Grace, He comes into our homes, through our infinite Love for the Guru.
By infinite love for the Guru, the Lord mercifully comes into the bride's home.
EHSP: The happy soul-bride obtains the One Lord as her Husband. ||7||
The happy bride obtains One God, the Enemy of pride, as he Bridegroom.
2NS5: All of her sins are forgiven; the Uniter unites her with Himself.
The Guru gets all her sins pardoned, and the Uniter unites her with Himself.
YDFP: O Nanak, chant such chants, that hearing them, He may enshrine love for you. ||8||12||34||
Nanak, utter you such words, hearing which your Master may cherish love for you.
7T3F: Merit is obtained from the True Guru, when God causes us to meet Him.
When that Lord causes us to meet the True Guru, We obtain merits from him.

2V82: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with intuitive ease and poise, spiritual wisdom is revealed. ||1||
By remembering the Name with mental poise, Divine Knowledge is manifested.
EF3P: O my mind, do not think of the Lord as being far away; behold Him ever close at hand.
O my Soul, think not God to be afar. Ever behold Him just close to you.
68FE: He is always listening, and always watching over us; the Word of His Shabad is all-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||
Ever He hears, ever He beholds, and fully pervading is He in the world. Pause.
RZ9G: The Gurmukhs understand their own selves; they meditate single-mindedly on the Lord.
The pious persons understand their ownself, and they contemplate over the Lord single mindedly.
WF13: They enjoy their Husband Lord continually; through the True Name, they find peace. ||2||
Ever they enjoy their Lord, and through the True Name they gather peace.
R0JZ: O my mind, no one belongs to you; contemplate the Shabad, and see this.
O my soul, none is yours. verify it by reflecting over the Guru's hymns.
9VJE: So run to the Lord's Sanctuary, and find the gate of salvation. ||3||
Hasten you into God's protection. You shall thus obtain the door of salvation.
8JQP: Listen to the Shabad, and understand the Shabad, and lovingly focus your consciousness on the True One.
Hear you the Name, understand you the Name, and keep you your attention fixed on the True Name.
DTVX: Through the Shabad, conquer your ego, and in the True Mansion of the Lord's Presence, you shall find peace. ||4||
Through the Name still your ego and obtain bliss in the Lord's true mansion.
5HBT: In this age, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glory; without the Name, there is no glory.
In this age, the glory is of the Name without the Lord's Name glory is gained not.
4RNA: The glory of this Maya lasts for only a few days; it disappears in an instant. ||5||
The greatness of these worldly valuables lasts for four days, and it makes no delay in disappearing.
QCSG: Those who forget the Naam are already dead, and they continue dying.
They who forget the Name, are dead, and shall continue dying.
0SZ5: They do not enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord's taste; they sink into the manure. ||6||
They enjoy not God's Nectar, and sink into ordure.
H0SX: Some are forgiven by the Lord; He unites them with Himself, and keeps them attached to the Naam, night and day.
Some the Lord Himself, night and say keeps attached with the Name. He pardons and unites them with Himself.
09B0: They practice Truth, and abide in Truth; being truthful, they merge into Truth. ||7||
They practise truth, abide in truth and being truthful merge in truth.
F6XD: Without the Shabad, the world does not hear, and does not see; deaf and blind, it wanders around.
Without the Name, the world hears and sees not, Being deaf and blind, it roams about at one large.
PX9R: Without the Naam, it obtains only misery; the Naam is received only by His Will. ||8||
Without the Name, it shall come to grief. The Name is received through His will.
Y8LL: Those persons who link their consciousness with the Word of His Bani, are immaculately pure, and approved by the Lord.
Pure and acceptable are the persons, who attach their mind to Guru's hymns.
09C9: O Nanak, they never forget the Naam, and in the Court of the Lord, they are known as true. ||9||13||35||
Nanak they forget not the Name ever, and in the Lord's court they are Known as true.
UT2M: Through the Word of the Shabad, the devotees are known; their words are true.
The saints, whose word is true, are renowned through the Lord's Name.
UX95: They eradicate ego from within themselves; they surrender to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and meet with the True One. ||1||
From within the egoism is eliminated, they worship the name, and meet the true Lord.
L37F: Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, His humble servants obtain honor.
By Lord God's Name, His slave obtains honour.
9FLM: How blessed is their coming into the world! Everyone adores them. ||1||Pause||
Accredited is their advent. Them every one adores. Pause.
5W5L: Ego, self-centeredness, excessive anger and pride are the lot of mankind.
Egotism, egoism, excessive wrath and haughtiness are the caste of men.
R8Y7: If one dies in the Word of the Shabad, then he is rid of this, and his light is merged into the Light of the Lord God. ||2||
If man dies by Guru's word, then He is rid of this caste, and his light unites with the Supreme Light of the Illustrious Lord.
PR4A: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, my life has been blessed.
Meeting the Perfect True Guru, my birth has become profitable.
5550: I have obtained the nine treasures of the Naam, and my storehouse is inexhaustible, filled to overflowing. ||3||
I have obtained the nine treasures of God Name and brimful and inexhaustible are my store.
BCCF: Those who love the Naam come as dealers in the merchandise of the Naam.
They, who love the Lord's Name, really come as the dealers of Name's merchandise.
Q6JC: Those who become Gurmukh obtain this wealth; deep within, they contemplate the Shabad. ||4||
They who become Guru-wards obtain this wealth, for within their mind they ponder on the Name.
S8WL: The egotistical, self-willed manmukhs do not appreciate the value of devotional worship.
The proud apostates know not the worth of Lord's worship.
2ERC: The Primal Lord Himself has beguiled them; they lose their lives in the gamble. ||5||
The Lord Himself has beguiled them; they lose their life game in gamble.
W6GD: Without loving affection, devotional worship is not possible, and the body cannot be at peace.
Without affections, meditation is not possible nor is the body at peace.
K2M8: The wealth of love is obtained from the Guru; through devotion, the mind becomes steady. ||6||
The wealth of love is obtained from the Guru and through Lord's service the soul becomes steady.
ZU2W: He alone performs devotional worship, whom the Lord so blesses; he contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
He alone performs Lord's service whom he blesses therewith and her reflects upon the Guru's hymns.
7QDW: The One Name abides in his heart, and he conquers his ego and duality. ||7||
In his mind abides the one Name alone and he stills his ego and duality.
51WX: The One Name is the social status and honor of the devotees; the Lord Himself adorns them.
The One Name is the caste and honour of Lord's devotees. He Himself bedecks them.
M9EY: They remain forever in the Protection of His Sanctuary. As it pleases His Will, He arranges their affairs. ||8||
They ever remain under His protection, and as it please Him so, does He arrange their affairs.

B9YQ: The worship of the Lord is unique - it is known only by reflecting upon the Guru.
The Lord's adoration is distinct in this that it is known through Guru's instruction alone.
B53K: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with the Naam, through the Lord's Fear and devotion, is embellished with the Naam. ||9||14||36||
Nanak he in whose mind the Name dwells through Lord's Fear and devotion he is embellished with His Name.
NJHE: He wanders around, engrossed in other pleasures, but without the Naam, he suffers in pain.
The mortal wanders about in other relishes. But without the Name he suffers agony.
A3P1: He does not meet the True Guru, the Primal Being, who imparts true understanding. ||1||
He meets not the Divine True Guru who imparts the True understanding.
1P8H: O my insane mind, drink in the sublime essence of the Lord, and savor its taste.
O my insane soul quaff you the God's elixir and enjoy its relish.
DL29: Attached to other pleasures, you wander around, and your life wastes away uselessly. ||1||Pause||
Attach to other pleasures you wanderest about and wastest your life in vain. Pause.
Y23Q: In this age, the Gurmukhs are pure; they remain absorbed in the love of the True Name.
In this age, stainless are the Guru-wards who remain absorbed in the love of the True Name.
0VX0: Without the destiny of good karma, nothing can be obtained; what can we say or do? ||2||
Without destiny (good luck) nothing can be obtained. What can we say or do?
6AYT: He understands his own self, and dies in the Word of the Shabad; he banishes corruption from his mind.
He, who banished wickedness from his mind, and dies by Guru's word, understand his ownself.
EQH3: He hurries to the Guru's Sanctuary, and is forgiven by the Forgiving Lord. ||3||
They who hasten to Guru's refuge, them pardons the Pardoner.
DNRD: Without the Name, peace is not obtained, and pain does not depart from within.
Without the Name, peace is not attained nor does pain depart from within.
PN9M: This world is engrossed in attachment to Maya; it has gone astray in duality and doubt. ||4||
This world is engrossed in the love of wealth and is gone astray in duality and doubt.
BKNS: The forsaken soul-brides do not know the value of their Husband Lord; how can they decorate themselves?
The untrue brides known not the worth of their Spouse. What shall they do by decorating themselves.
UAKL: Night and day, they continually burn, and they do not enjoy the Bed of their Husband Lord. ||5||
Night and day they ever keep on burning and enjoy not the couch for their Spouse.
GCQ9: The happy soul-brides obtain the Mansion of His Presence, eradicating their self-conceit from within.
Stilling their self-conceit, from within, the true brides attain to their Lord's palace.
82S9: They decorate themselves with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and their Husband Lord unites them with Himself. ||6||
With Guru's hymns, they are adorned, and their Husband blends them with Himself.
UN1Z: He has forgotten death, in the darkness of attachment to Maya.
In the darkness of mammon's attachment the man has forgotten death from his mind.
H5B5: The self-willed manmukhs die again and again, and are reborn; they die again, and are miserable at the Gate of Death. ||7||
The self-ward repeatedly die and are re-born. Die they again, and become miserable at Death's door.
WM38: They alone are united, whom the Lord unites with Himself; they contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
They, whom the Lord Himself unites, unite with Him by deliberating over Gurbani.
YVGQ: O Nanak, they are absorbed in the Naam; their faces are radiant, in that True Court. ||8||22||15||37||
Nanak, in that true court, exonerated become the faces of those, who are absorbed in the Lord's Name.
SYK7: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:
0KNA: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By True Guru's grace, He is obtained.
G9KB: In this way, the village of my body became inhabited, O my Siblings of Destiny.
In this way the village of my body was peopled, O my brother.
FNRM: Vice departed, and the Guru's spiritual wisdom was implanted within me. ||1||Pause||
They vice departed, and the Guru established gnosis within me. Pause.
2R4H: The fence of true Dharmic religion has been built around it.
Round this habitation, the Guru has put a fence of the True Religion.
V28W: The spiritual wisdom and reflective meditation of the Guru has become its strong gate. ||2||
The Guru given Divine knowledge and meditation form its strong plank gate.
LLCA: So plant the seed of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O friends, O Siblings of Destiny.
Sow the crop of Lord's Name, O my brother and friend.
01TG: Deal only in the constant service of the Guru. ||3||
Ever strike the bargain of the service of the Guru.
P8SR: With intuitive peace and happiness, all the shops are filled.
With peace, poise and happiness are filled all the ships.
8H7D: The Banker and the dealers dwell in the same place. ||4||
The Guru banker and the Sikh dealer, abide in the one place.
S3NE: There is no tax on non-believers, nor any fines or taxes at death.
Now, the infidel tax, fine and terminal tax are levied not,
4T4H: The True Guru has set the Seal of the Primal Lord upon these goods. ||5||
as the True Guru has set God's seal.
T8UU: So load the merchandise of the Naam, and set sail with your cargo.
Load you the merchandise of the Name, and dispatch the cargo.
BGLK: Earn your profit, as Gurmukh, and you shall return to your own home. ||6||
So shall you earn profit under Guru's instruction and return home.
QQL1: The True Guru is the Banker, and His Sikhs are the traders.
The True Guru is the wholesale dealer and his Sikhs the retail vendors.
ZLBG: Their merchandise is the Naam, and meditation on the True Lord is their account. ||7||
The stock-in-trade is the Lord's Name and the meditation of the True Lord, the account.
0TC8: One who serves the True Guru dwells in this house.
He, who serves the Perfect Guru, abides in this house of God.
GRKY: O Nanak, the Divine City is eternal. ||8||1||
O Nanak, immovable is the Lord's city.
